'''Interrogator''' was an [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] that joined the [[Directive 7]] movement headed by [[Mentor]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. Adopting a new name of its own choosing, Interrogator was among the droids that gathered on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zadd]] under Mentor's leadership, and was one of the few droids who were not absorbed into Mentor's consciousness. Interrogator was involved in Mentor's experiments with converting organics into [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]], and Interrogator was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] while trying to protect Mentor's core from invaders.

==Behind the scenes==
Interrogator appears as a bonus boss in the Flashpoint "Directive 7" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
